backbone.name: imagenet
backbone.note: Feature backbone is frozen (no weights are updated during training).

calibration.note: Calibration was fitted on ID_VAL only. A validation-only gain is NOT evidence of improved OOD performance; OOD metrics are reported separately from a distinct, untouched split. Temperature scaling and a constant class logit shift preserve the within-class logit ordering and cannot manufacture class separation that the representation lacks.

claim_boundary: Any temperature/logit adjustment was fitted on ID_VAL only; OOD labels were never used for fitting or for checkpoint selection. No OOD improvement is inferred from a validation-only gain.

default_rationale.balanced_sampler: off by default to avoid triple correction; opt in with --balanced-sampler
default_rationale.class_weight: weights n/(K*count) are computed from TRAIN labels only
default_rationale.early_metric: balanced_accuracy prevents a collapsed single-class model from being checkpointed
default_rationale.loss: focal down-weights easy examples; --loss ce --class-weight balanced gives standard balanced CE
default_rationale.temperature_calibration: temperature (+ logit adjustment) fitted on ID_VAL only; never on OOD
